item.title: City Combines Housing Units with New Fire Station
item.description: The Tempe (AZ) City Council approved $6.6 million for a project co-locating affordable housing and a fire station, marking significant steps in addressing housing and safety priorities. item.title: E-ONE Delivers MPAV and IP to Saudi Aramco
item.description: E-ONE has delivered a multipurpose attack vehicle (MPAV) and an industrial pumper (IP) completing a six-vehicle order for Aramco. item.title: Pumper Slides Off Icy Road Into Ditch in NH
item.description: A Wentworth (NH) Fire Department pumper slid off an icy road into a ditch while leaving a truck fire scene. No injuries were reported, and minor damage occurred to the apparatus. The post Pumper Slides Off Icy Road Into Ditch in NH appeared first on Fire Apparatus: Fire trucks, fire engines, emergency vehicles, and firefighting equipment.

item.description: Joint Base San Antonio (TX) operates five locations with nine fire stations and 54 vehicles, including a new Rosenbauer Panther 6×6 ARFF truck designed for enhanced firefighting capabilities. item.title: IL Expands ‘Move Over’ Law
item.description: Illinois enacted updates to Scott's Law, expanding protections to moving emergency vehicles and workers as of January 1. Violations can result in fines up to $10,000. The post IL Expands ‘Move Over’ Law appeared first on Fire Apparatus: Fire trucks, fire engines, emergency vehicles, and firefighting equipment.

item.title: Retired Fire Truck Used for Winter Storm Rescues: ‘Why Not Help People?’
item.description: Ryan DuVal used his fire truck to rescue more than 50 people during Winter Storm Fern in Tulsa, Oklahoma, providing shelter and assistance to those stranded in harsh conditions. item.title: Fire and EMS Vehicles Slide Into Ditch in VA
item.description: Icy conditions hindered emergency response in Prince George County, VA, causing vehicles to slide into ditches. No serious injuries occurred, and VDOT was notified for road treatment.
